issues.title: Boundary helper time strings with timezone suffixes were malformed
issues.scope: CQL HighBoundary/LowBoundary public DuckDB helper surfaces, Python fallback, and native C++ browser surface
issues.finding: HighBoundary/LowBoundary accepted time strings from public helper and conversion surfaces but appended filled components after the timezone suffix or misparsed negative offsets, producing malformed values such as T10:30Z:59.999 and T10:-0--5:T0.
issues.resolution: Python fallback and native C++ boundary helpers now split and preserve Z/+HH:MM/-HH:MM suffixes while filling time components. The CQL translator still rejects @T...Z/+/- literals because the official XML treats those as invalid time literals.

issues.title: Python fallback boundary helpers treated numeric strings as temporal text
issues.scope: CQL HighBoundary/LowBoundary Python fallback parity with native C++
issues.finding: HighBoundary('1.587', 8) and LowBoundary('1.587', 8) in forced Python fallback went through temporal parsing, returning NULL or date-shaped output instead of decimal boundary strings. A naive numeric-string fix would regress official year-only date precision cases such as HighBoundary(@2014, 6).
issues.resolution: Python fallback boundary helpers now route numeric strings through decimal boundary logic while preserving four-digit year-only date strings as temporal year precision.
